segments.translation: Nix를 사용해 패키지 빌드하기

segments.source: Build a Nix [package](/concepts/packages) defined in [Nixpkgs](/concepts/nixpkgs)

segments.source: While [Nix] can do many things, [package management][pkg] is the thing that it's perhaps best known for.
segments.translation: [Nix]는 여러 가지 일을 할 수 있지만, 아마도 가장 잘 알려진 것은 [패키지 관리][pkg]일 것입니다.

segments.source: In this tutorial, we'll use our [installed Nix CLI][install] to build and run some Nix [packages] included in [Nixpkgs].
segments.translation: 이 튜토리얼에서는 [설치한 Nix CLI][install]를 사용해 [Nixpkgs]에 포함된 몇몇 Nix [패키지][packages]를 빌드하고 실행해 보겠습니다.

segments.source: Later in the guide we'll build and run a Nix package defined in a local [flake].

segments.source: In this section, we'll explore that by building and running packages for tools written in a variety of languages.
